meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱问答代码库，快速理解代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库的结构和逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Query codebase with knowledge graph to understand code quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and logic of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 读取项目根目录的 .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json，用检索方式找匹配的节点、沿边查看上下游依赖，据此回答代码库问题并指向具体文件、函数与所属分层。
howto.when: 当你需要就代码库提问、或借助知识图谱理解代码时触发。若项目根目录没有该图谱文件，它会先让你运行 /understand。

say.text: 登录逻辑在哪些文件里？
say.note: 会从图谱找匹配节点和相连的边

say.text: config 层里有哪些节点，依赖什么？
say.note: 会查 layers 与 edges 给出依赖链

say.text: 支付流程经过哪些函数，谁调用它们？
say.note: 会返回节点 id 及上下游连接

howto.what_en: Reads .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json in the project root, greps node names, summaries and tags, follows edges to related nodes, and answers codebase questions pointing to specific files, functions and layers.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code via the knowledge graph. If the graph file is missing, it tells you to run /understand first.

say_en.text: Which files hold the login logic?
say_en.note: Finds matching nodes and their edges.

say_en.text: What does the config layer contain and depend on?
Which functions does the payment flow call?
